summary: All six R1 completeness findings (CMP-MAJ-001/002, CMP-MIN-001/002, CMP-nit-001/002) are genuinely closed in the plan-doc body. The fix-round-1 edits introduced three new MAJ findings, all located in DISPATCH-NOTE.md rather than the plan-doc itself: (1) line 36 carries a double-stale cross-reference — §5.5 now points to the cross-repo coordination table, not Threshold A telemetry, and §10 Q7 no longer exists; (2) criterion (xi) still says '(10 questions)' after §10 was trimmed to 3; (3) the Forward-looking section still cites 'WP-SCP-025 is open question §10 Q7' — §10 Q7 was renumbered to Q2. One additional nit is filed for the criterion (vi) summary omitting the new §5.5 cross-repo coordination section. findings.title: DISPATCH-NOTE line 36 carries a double-stale cross-reference: '§10 Q7 / §5.5' — both pointers are broken after fix-round-1
findings.evidence: docs/reviews/WP-SCP-024/dispatches/024A-plan-doc/DISPATCH-NOTE.md line 36 (scope OUT table row for '.github/workflows/scorecard-aggregator.yml extensions'): 'Aggregator extensions land at 024G if at all (open question per §10 Q7 / §5.5 — may be rolled into existing consult_scorecard instead).' After CMP-MAJ-001 fix, §10 now contains exactly 3 questions (Q1, Q2, Q3) — there is no §10 Q7. After CMP-MAJ-002 fix, §5.5 is now the 'Cross-repo coordination (notifications)' table, not the Threshold A telemetry section (which moved to §5.6). The MCP-method decision referenced by that OUT-row is now in §5.6 + §8 (the D-046 informational note) + §9 D-046 reservation row. The stale pointers are in a normative governance artefact (DISPATCH-NOTE is the canonical slice record) and will mislead any reader auditing the scope table against the plan-doc structure.
findings.recommendation: Update DISPATCH-NOTE line 36 to read: 'Aggregator extensions land at 024G if at all (decision deferred to D-046 per §5.6 + §9; MCP-method vs. consult_scorecard extension is open per §10 Q2 WP-SCP-025 successor context — not pre-committed in this plan-doc).' The reference must point to the correct section numbers (§5.6 for Threshold A telemetry, §10 Q2 for WP-SCP-025 successor) after the renumbering.

findings.title: DISPATCH-NOTE criterion (xi) still asserts '(10 questions)' after §10 was trimmed to 3 — the acceptance criterion is factually inconsistent with the delivered plan-doc
findings.evidence: docs/reviews/WP-SCP-024/dispatches/024A-plan-doc/DISPATCH-NOTE.md line 59, criterion (xi): '(xi) Forward-looking + open questions. §10 captures questions that should be revisited at each implementation slice (10 questions).' After CMP-MAJ-001 inline-fix, §10 now contains exactly 3 genuinely open questions. The acceptance criterion states '(10 questions)' — a number that no longer matches the plan-doc and that derives from the old pre-fix DISPATCH-NOTE criterion language that R1 CMP-MAJ-001 identified as the source of the problem (the criterion was anchoring §10 to 10 questions regardless of whether they were genuinely open). Leaving criterion (xi) at '(10 questions)' means that any R2/R3 reviewer running the acceptance checklist against the plan-doc will observe criterion (xi) failing — §10 has 3 entries, not 10. It also re-introduces the exact structural confusion that CMP-MAJ-001 fixed: future implementation-slice authors reading the DISPATCH-NOTE will infer §10 should have 10 entries and may treat the current 3 as incomplete.
findings.recommendation: Update DISPATCH-NOTE criterion (xi) to read: '(xi) Forward-looking + open questions. §10 captures the genuinely open questions that implementation slices must revisit (3 questions at v0.1: Renovate coverage, WP-SCP-025 successor, --restore test surface). Questions resolved at plan-doc level are NOT included — see §10 explanatory header (closes 024A R1 CMP-MAJ-001 per §10 header note).' Remove the hard count anchor or replace with 'at least 1 genuinely open question' to prevent the same inflation recurrence.

findings.evidence: docs/reviews/WP-SCP-024/dispatches/024A-plan-doc/DISPATCH-NOTE.md line 103 (Forward-looking section): 'WP-SCP-025 is open question §10 Q7 — not pre-committed in this plan-doc.' The DISPATCH-NOTE Forward-looking section is the canonical forward-reference anchor used by STATUS.md backfill + memory updates; a wrong Q-number here propagates staleness into those downstream records.
findings.recommendation: Update DISPATCH-NOTE line 103 to: 'WP-SCP-025 is open question §10 Q2 — not pre-committed in this plan-doc.' (The Q-number must match the renumbered §10 in the plan-doc.)
